run_laikago_rollouts: run expert policy rollouts on the Laikago quadruped robot environment and print return statistics
create_laikago_env: create a Laikago quadruped Gym environment with GIN config files and rendering enabled
load_expert_policy: load an expert policy from an npz file and instantiate a neural or linear policy
run_policy_rollout_loop: run a rollout loop that collects observations, actions, and returns from the policy
review_create_laikago_env: review the create_laikago_env function to understand GIN config file loading and environment setup
